hud.elements.trackView.name: Track View
hud.elements.trackView.settings.showThum: Displays album art or a media placeholder.
hud.elements.trackView.settings.imageSiz: Controls cover image size in pixels.
hud.elements.trackView.settings.showSour: Shows the player application name (for example Spotify or browser session).
hud.elements.trackView.settings.showProg: Displays media progress when duration and position are available.
hud.elements.trackView.settings.hideWhen: Hides the element when no active media session is available.
hud.elements.trackView.settings.compactM: Uses a denser layout with less vertical space.
